business: Credit memo service for UK SME lending. Takes 12 months of business current-account statements and returns a memo in which every figure is calculated deterministically, cited to its source transactions, and approved by a named human before release.
target: Credit analyst or head of credit at a UK non-bank SME lender (about 10-50 staff), or the packager at an NACFB commercial-finance broker, who spreads 12 months of statements before a memo is written.

cards.name: Omar
cards.segment: Credit analyst at a 10-50 person non-bank SME lender (GUESS)
cards.how: Spreading and the memo are the analyst's own judgement. They will not hand that over and will say the current way works (GUESS, D3).
cards.habit: Learns about tools from NACFB events, trade press and peers, not from cold email.
cards.objection: Crediflow already fills our own memo template with source traceability and has UK lender customers. What do you do that they do not?
